correctness.rationale: The fixed-parameter Simon restaurant dynamics give an exact \(\operatorname{Beta}(1,r)\) relative two-table urn. The gambler hitting formula yields \(h_r=2^{-r}\) and \(g_r=2^{-r}+r\int_0^{1/2}x^r/(1-x)\,dx\). Single specified births contribute independently to first order; pair intersections need two mutations. The omitted infinite tail is bounded by independent Bernoulli lower coupling on root growth from an unmutated early state, and late newcomers following finitely many earlier mutations vanish conditionally by a finite-history continuity argument. The one-time leadership coefficient uses a finite-family squeeze, so no infinite-maximum interchange is assumed. Absolute positive-sum exchange evaluates the coefficients 1 and 3/2; no numerical extrapolation is needed. The finite-horizon rational checker passed 309 diagnostic assertions.

value.rationale: The precise comparison of ultimate and perpetual component leadership is central to the random recursive-tree percolation model. Distinct sharp coefficients show that transient leadership reversals account for a positive first-order proportion of failure even near deterministic retention. Identifying this gap is a structural, model-specific endpoint law and the infinite-challenger tail control is not a routine finite-binomial calculation.
